title: ShredEQLookAndFeel — suite visual identity, analytical palette, correct JUCE overrides
description:
Implement ShredEQLookAndFeel as the suite visual identity for the diagnostic EQ GUI per SHREDEQ_SPEC.md §13.9 and known JUCE LookAndFeel_V4 override rules.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.

Before editing, inspect:
- .abracapocus/SHREDEQ_SPEC.md §13.1 window behavior, §13.9 visual appearance (analytical, darker/more measurement-oriented than boost/space plugins)
- any existing Source/PluginEditor.* skeleton from phase A for default sizing hooks
- JUCE LookAndFeel_V4 headers for drawPopupMenuItem, drawRotarySlider, drawLinearSlider, drawComboBox, drawButtonBackground, drawToggleButton, getTypefaceForFont
- sibling suite LookAndFeel patterns under /home/mike/dev/mike/music/plugins/ if present (palette restraint; do not copy non-analytical neon aesthetics)

Implement Source/UI/ShredEQLookAndFeel.h and Source/UI/ShredEQLookAndFeel.cpp:
1. class ShredEQLookAndFeel : public juce::LookAndFeel_V4.
2. Analytical dark-neutral palette: deep background, restrained luminous accent for meters/analysis, high-contrast response-curve colours reserved as public Colour constants for Stage A / adaptive layer / Stage B, colour-blind-safe routing indicator colours, muted text secondary colour.
3. Correct LookAndFeel_V4 overrides using the modern individual-parameter signatures — especially drawPopupMenuItem with discrete parameters (isSeparator, isActive, isHighlighted, text, shortcutKeyText, iconToDraw, isTicked) — NOT the obsolete PopupMenu::Item API overload.
4. Override common controls used by inspector/header: rotary/linear sliders, combo boxes, text buttons, toggle buttons, labels, scrollbars, popup menus, tooltip window style. Keep animations minimal — only where executing code communication is later needed; no decorative motion.
5. Expose named Colour getters or public static Colour members for workspace consumers (background, panel, grid, stageA, adaptive, stageB, selection, bypass, danger/audition).
6. Optional default Typeface setup if suite font assets are unavailable — fall back to LookAndFeel_V4 defaults without crashing.

Do not implement EQWorkspace, BandNode, InspectorPanel, IntelligenceDrawer, PluginEditor assembly, or CMakeLists.txt.
acceptance_criteria: drawPopupMenuItem uses the individual-parameter LookAndFeel_V4 signature and does not use PopupMenu::Item API
LookAndFeel exposes named analytical palette colours including distinct Stage A / adaptive / Stage B response colours
Slider, ComboBox, TextButton/ToggleButton, and popup menu drawing overrides are present
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: implement EQWorkspace, BandNode, InspectorPanel, or IntelligenceDrawer
add third-party dependencies or binary font packs outside allowed paths

allowed: LookAndFeel_V4 subclass with modern override signatures
public Colour constants / getters for suite analytical palette
fallback default typeface when custom fonts absent
